title: The Enforcement and Feasibility of Hate Speech Moderation on Twitter

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing platform enforcement (tweet removal and user suspension rates), moderator workforce allocation, and the predictive performance (average precision) of automated hate speech detection models across eight major languages.

Using linear probability models to estimate disparities in tweet removal and account suspension likelihoods for users posting comparable hate speech across four different English-speaking countries (US, India, Nigeria, and Kenya).
